publicationTiming: Prepare at 09:00 IST; target deployment at 10:00 IST. If preparation is missing, the publishing job prepares and validates the pair in that run. Catch-up checks at 11:00 and 12:00 IST resume only unfinished work. Public availability follows successful deployment.

preparation: Read the source registry, editorial archive and prior daily output; select one unprofiled founder and one distinct timely business insight.

Verify facts against accessible specific sources; each article needs at least two distinct source links. Record reporting dates and financial periods. Unknown birth details and quotations remain empty.

Find and visually inspect a genuine photograph for each article from an official company/founder page, press media kit or appropriately licensed source. Verify the subject identity and provide local image, imageAlt, imageCaption, imageCredit and HTTPS imageSourceUrl. Logos and fabricated portraits do not satisfy this requirement. If a suitable sourced photo cannot be obtained, keep the package unready and report the specific image limitation.

Write the dated package atomically, with sources after core fields and image metadata. Record photo source page, original asset URL, identity, credit, access date, dimensions, checksum and usage context in the separate dated research note inside .daily-editorial.
Run the helper with --input <package> --check-only before marking the pair ready. Do not modify article arrays, commit or push during preparation.
publication: Resolve today’s IST date explicitly and inspect current-date package, research, pending-push record and published receipt before choosing content. If a receipt exists, verify the published pair and remain quiet when healthy. Never publish an older date’s package as today’s pair.

If a pending-push record exists, resume its exact SHA and pair; do not prepare or commit a replacement. If no pending or published record exists and today’s package/research is absent or invalid, perform the full preparation workflow in this publishing run: fresh research, novelty checks, verified English drafts, real local credited photos, atomic current-date package and research notes, and helper --check-only. Repair or choose accessible sources/photos within scope until the pair validates. Report a failure only if an actual unresolved verification, image, repository or deployment limitation remains; a missing 9 AM package alone is a recovery trigger, not a final failure.
Check that the checkout is on main and has no unrelated tracked changes or staged files. Leave video-edits and other unrelated untracked files untouched.
Fetch origin and require a clean fast-forward to origin/main. Never reset, stash, switch another user's branch, force-push or overwrite unrelated work automatically.
Apply the helper to the package. Validate the resulting two records, genuine local photos and their image metadata/source credits, direct citations, generated OG entries and sitemap URLs.
Run the full production build and the focused publishing/metadata regression tests. A failed check blocks publication.
Stage only the two editorial data files and the exact images associated with the pair. Inspect the staged diff. Commit the pair in one scoped commit and push main to origin/main.
Monitor Vercel status for the exact pushed SHA, then verify the two custom-domain article pages and their listing entries. Only then write the publication receipt and report success with both URLs.
If deployment fails after push, report the pushed SHA and actual status; do not publish a second pair or claim completion. A retry should resume verification of that SHA.

runtime.build: npm run build using the configured Node runtime
runtime.tests: npm run test:editorial using the configured Node runtime

recoveryPolicy.missingPreparation: Prepare in the publishing run using the same full editorial and photo contract.
recoveryPolicy.invalidPreparation: Repair the unpublished package after checking no existing IDs, pending SHA or published receipt.
recoveryPolicy.alreadyPublished: Verify receipt and stay quiet when both URLs and photos are healthy; do not duplicate.
recoveryPolicy.pendingPush: Resume exact recorded SHA, matching local package and IDs; never create another pair.
recoveryPolicy.preparationFailed: Save a dated preparation failure note with the concrete reason, attempted sources/photo retrievals and unfinished step. Publishing may retry independently.
recoveryPolicy.notifications: Notify on verified publication, newly actionable failure or required user action; stay quiet on healthy repeat checks.
recoveryPolicy.localExecution: Local scheduled work requires this computer on, Codex running and the workspace available; catch-up checks reduce dependence on a single wake-up but are not a cloud scheduler.
